episodes.name: episode ep1
episodes.content: Alice Johnson works at Acme Corporation.

events.message: embedded entity n-plain name (10 chars) in <ms> ms

events.query:
UNWIND $episodes AS episode
                MERGE (n:Episodic {uuid: episode.uuid})
                SET n = {uuid: episode.uuid, name: episode.name, group_id: episode.group_id, source_description: episode.source_description, source: episode.source, content: episode.content, 
                entity_edges: episode.entity_edges, created_at: episode.created_at, valid_at: episode.valid_at}
                RETURN n.uuid AS uuid

values.name: episode ep1
values.content: Alice Johnson works at Acme Corporation.

events.query:
UNWIND $nodes AS node
                    MERGE (n:Entity {uuid: node.uuid})
                    SET n:$(node.labels)
                    SET n = node
                    WITH n, node CALL db.create.setNodeVectorProperty(n, "name_embedding", node.name_embedding)
                RETURN n.uuid AS uuid

UNWIND $episodic_edges AS edge
        MATCH (episode:Episodic {uuid: edge.source_node_uuid})
        MATCH (node:Entity {uuid: edge.target_node_uuid})
        MERGE (episode)-[e:MENTIONS {uuid: edge.uuid}]->(node)
        SET
            e.group_id = edge.group_id,
            e.created_at = edge.created_at
        RETURN e.uuid AS uuid

UNWIND $entity_edges AS edge
                    MATCH (source:Entity {uuid: edge.source_node_uuid})
                    MATCH (target:Entity {uuid: edge.target_node_uuid})
                    MERGE (source)-[e:RELATES_TO {uuid: edge.uuid}]->(target)
                    SET e = edge
                    WITH e, edge CALL db.create.setRelationshipVectorProperty(e, "fact_embedding", edge.fact_embedding)
                RETURN edge.uuid AS uuid
